# Nginx ACME (letsencrypt)

## Project goal

Provide an easy way to generate SSL certificates via [Let's
Encrypt](https://letsencrypt.org).

## Project details

- **Project:** <https://github.com/bigxu/nginx-acme>

- **Based on:** <https://github.com/neilpang/acme.sh>
